أحتظر (form VIII)
# أَحْتَظِرُ (ʔaḥtaẓiru) /ʔaħ.ta.ðˤi.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَظَرَ (iḥtaẓara)
# أَحْتَظِرَ (ʔaḥtaẓira) /ʔaħ.ta.ðˤi.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَظَرَ (iḥtaẓara)
# أَحْتَظِرْ (ʔaḥtaẓir) /ʔaħ.ta.ðˤir/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِحْتَظَرَ (iḥtaẓara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
